newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed but demand lacklustre.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed but demand lacklustre.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday with overall demand generally thin.
Gasoline was steady in very quiet trade, supported by U.S. supply data and arb interest.
Naphtha was steady but end-user demand quiet.
Gas oil slid $1.50 a tonne with futures. Flat demand kept cargo and barge heating oil premiums under pressure.
Fuel oil barges slipped $1 trading at $117 fob ARA. Low sulphur cargoes were also several dollars weaker.
